title: FeltCraft-Lifetimes v2 exact coupled CPU instrument and dormant lifetime-memory claim ladder
summary: Replace the causally confounded v1 instrument with a finite, no-rejection FeltCraft-Lifetimes v2 population in which RANDOM and MOTIF share the hidden physical graph, open-loop source actions, public outcomes, target bytes, and correct actions and differ only in source descriptor alignment. This proposal grants no present authority. Only after full deliberation and exact-byte human ratification may the five requested scope atoms implement and falsify the deterministic local CPU generator, source/target decks, exact posterior controllers, leakage checks, prefix-free codecs, resource records, isolation tests, and receipts. Scientific DREAM/SLEEP/reader code, tokenizers, models/providers, weights/LoRA, GPU or remote work, locked studies, promotion, and scientific claims remain absent and forbidden.
system_thesis: The paper asks when a fixed pretrained agent should compile its own immutable public action--outcome lifetime into connected lossy experiential knowledge rather than retain exact text or graph memory as genuinely new causal structure accumulates beyond native context. V2 identifies reusable cross-instance descriptor alignment at fixed realized physical experience; counterfactual twins separately test authentic-life dependence. DREAM may later propose but never certify, ordinary public outcomes ground, SLEEP only deterministically compiles supported content, LoRA only transports or amortizes an identical corpus, and recurrent THINK performs bounded retrieval and composition. CPU v2 can establish only deterministic instrument eligibility; every representation, development, schema, compression, transport, and flywheel rung requires a separate later authorization and its own evidence.
